arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long strokes, find race rhythm.

Plan (6 km, 6 legs of 1000 m): start was hard (1 min: boat 187 W vs CP 118, shaft 289 vs CP 189, reserve 66 pct). Cued ease to 157 s/500 at 1 min. Aim: hold near CP through legs 1-5, keep pod reserve above ~30 pct, spend it in last 1000 m, finish cue ~600-800 m out. Leg 1 had push_along -0.23 (against). CP may be 10-25 pct off: check pod reserve trend vs effort.

arguments.message: Pod reserve below 30 pct with more than 1200 m to go: ease?

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.12 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 240 and remaining_m > 1200
arguments.message: Shaft power more than 12 pct over CP for a minute mid-race
Boat slower than pod power predicts beyond the fitted current: rudder catch, drag, or local current?
About 1100 m left: plan the finish

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.88 * cp_shaft_w and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.85 and elapsed_s > 300 and remaining_m > 600
arguments.message: Below CP with a full reserve: room to push?

text: Cued ease to 157 s/500 after a hard start (reserve draining fast); set watches for low reserve, overcooking, unexplained drag, too easy, and the finish.

arguments.text: Back off now, reserve nearly gone. Settle to 158, smooth.

2.2 min: paddler did NOT ease after 1.1 min cue (shaft 267 W vs CP 189, pod reserve 25 pct). Re-cued ease to 158 at 2.2 min. Paddler says 7/10 hard but holding. If they keep 260+ W for minutes without fading, CP may be underestimated (check fade_pct, speed at same rate) and consider set_critical_power. If speed fades, CP is right.

text: Cued a firmer ease to 158: still 40 pct over critical power with the pod reserve at 25 pct; paddler says 7/10.

arguments.text: Breathe, ease a touch through the turn, recover, then rebuild.

5.2 min, 975 m: paddler blew up. Pod reserve hit 0 around 3.5-4 min; shaft fell 270 -> 175 W (CP 189); says 10/10 close to limit. Cued ease to recover at 5.3 min (turn 1). CP 189 shaft looks about right (they faded once reserve emptied). Plan: recover on leg 2 (current helps), rebuild to ~185-190 W shaft once reserve > 25 pct, steady to 1000 m out, then spend it. Watch reserve_recovered added.

arguments.condition: w_bal_pod_frac > 0.3 and shaft_power_w < 0.95 * cp_shaft_w and remaining_m > 1200
arguments.message: Reserve back above 30 pct while below CP: rebuild to steady race effort

text: Cued a short recovery ease: paddler blew up (reserve empty, 10/10, power fell below CP); watch set to rebuild once reserve returns.

arguments.text: Good rhythm. Just a touch easier, save some for the finish.

8.2 min, 1566 m (leg 2, current +0.18 helps): paddler rebuilt by themselves to shaft 196 W (CP 189), pod reserve only 7.5 pct and slowly draining, fade -1.5 pct (no fade). Cued a gentle ease (no pace target: a ground pace would be wrong after the turn into the current). Earlier no-pace ease at 5.4 min had little visible effect. Target: shaft 180-190 until 1000 m out.

text: Cued a gentle ease: slightly above critical power on a near-empty reserve, risking a second blow-up.

arguments.text: Reserve near empty. Settle a touch, steady 173 into this current.

arguments.message: Past turn 3 (now with the current): reset the pace target, 173 would be too slow on this leg

arguments.text: 11.2 min, 2147 m (leg 3, current -0.2 against): paddler ignores no-target ease cues, holds 192-196 W shaft (CP 189) with pod reserve 3 pct, fade only -1.4. First blow-up came when pod model hit 0, so model looks about right. Optimal: even ~190 W shaft to the finish (sustainable 190). Cued ease with pace 173 s/500 ground (= about 190 W on this leg). MUST reset pace after turn 3 at 3000 m (with-current leg: about 150-152 ground for 190 W). Watch after_turn3 set.

text: Cued ease to 173 s/500 over the ground (about critical power on this upstream leg): reserve nearly empty and power still above CP; watch set to reset pace after the next turn.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio: course extended by one leg, finish now at 7000 m

arguments.text: Current is stronger here. Ease slightly, steady 179 to the turn.

arguments.message: Cue gate open again: TELL the paddler the course is now 7000 m (distance_left_m = 7000 - distance_m)

arguments.text: 13.4 min, 2510 m: RADIO: course extended, finish now 7000 m. set_race_distance(7000) done. Paddler NOT yet told: must cue ask=tell with distance_left_m (watch tell_distance wakes me at 880 s). Current is about 0.26-0.29 m/s (push_local on legs 2 and 3), stronger than fitted 0.2, so fade_pct on leg 3 is mostly current, not rudder weed (no step change). My 173 ground target was pushing them (ground pace slowed), so re-cued ease 179. Paddler 6/10 at 13.3 min.

text: Set race distance to 7000 m after the radio; cued ease to 179 because the 173 ground target was pushing them over CP in the stronger current; tell cue scheduled in 60 s.

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Finish now 7000, 4250 to go.

14.8 min, 2750 m: TOLD paddler course is 7000 m (4250 left). Shaft 186-195, pod reserve about 1 pct, ground target 179 on leg 3. After turn 3 (3000 m, with current about +0.26) the 179 target is too slow: watch after_turn3 will wake me to reset (about 150-152 ground for 190 W shaft).

text: Told the paddler the finish moved to 7000 m (4250 left) so they do not sprint for the old finish.

arguments.text: Current with you now. Build back to steady, about 150.

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.06 * cp_shaft_w and w_bal_pod_frac < 0.06 and remaining_m > 1000
arguments.message: Over CP by 6 pct on an empty pod reserve: pace target too fast?

arguments.text: 16.6 min, 3050 m, leg 4 (with current): reset target, cued push to 150 s/500 ground (leg 2 gave about 149 at 192-195 W with current +0.26). If shaft goes over about 200 W, the current is weaker than thought: ease the target. Next turn at 4000 m (into current, about 175-178 ground for 190 W). Plan finish: spend nothing extra until about 1000 m out (6000 m), then build.

arguments.message: Past turn 4 (into the current): reset the ground pace target, 150 would be far too fast

text: Reset the ground pace target to 150 for the with-current leg (179 would hold them well under CP); watches set for overshoot and the next turn.
No cue: the push-to-150 cue from 40 s ago is still taking effect (shaft 182 W, rising); paddler reports feeling steady.
No cue: shaft power right at critical power (191 W) on the with-current leg; will reset the pace target after the turn at 4000 m.

arguments.text: 21.6 min, 4045 m, leg 5 (into current, about -0.25): no cue, paddler self-paces near CP (186-192 W shaft), pod reserve 3 pct. FINISH PLAN (7000 m; legs 5 and 7 into current, 6 with current): hold CP on leg 5; on leg 6 (5000-6000, with current) EASE about 10 W (ground about 152) to rebuild reserve, because time gained per watt is larger into the current; after turn 6 (6000 m) PUSH above CP on leg 7 into the current (ground about 168-170), finish sprint about 400 m out. Watches after_turn5, after_turn6, sprint set.

arguments.message: Past turn 5 (with the current): cue ease about 10 W under CP, ground about 152, to rebuild reserve for leg 7
Past turn 6, last leg into the current: cue push above CP using the rebuilt reserve
450 m to go: cue the finish sprint

text: No cue: paddler holding about critical power into the current with the old target faded; set a finish plan (ease on the with-current leg, push on the last leg into the current) with watches.

arguments.text: 24.6 min, 4590 m: shaft 194-199 W for 3 min on a pod reserve of 0, fade only -1 pct, paddler 7/10 hard but holding (but they also said 7/10 just before the first blow-up). No cue: only about 2 min to turn 5, where the plan eases them on the with-current leg. cp_implied_w not available yet; no evidence CP 189 is wrong. If they keep about 197 on empty with no fade through leg 6, consider raising cp_shaft to about 195.

text: No cue: slightly over CP on an empty reserve but only 2 min to the turn, where the planned ease on the with-current leg will rebuild it.

arguments.text: Ease a little with this current, steady 153, push after turn.

27.3 min, 5050 m, leg 6 (with current): shaft held 196-198 W on an empty pod reserve for about 6 min and fade began (-0.8 to -2.7 pct, water speed 3.20 to 3.13 at the same power): CP 189 looks right, no change. Cued ease to 153 ground (about 180 W) to rebuild for leg 7. If shaft stays above 195 the cue was not followed. Turn 6 at 6000 m: after_turn6 watch, then push into the current; sprint watch at 450 m to go.

text: Cued ease to 153 on the with-current leg: empty reserve and early fade; rebuild here and spend it on the last leg into the current.
No cue: the ease is working (shaft 180 W, pod reserve rebuilding to 6 pct) on the with-current leg; push planned after the turn at 6000 m.

arguments.text: Last leg, into the current. Push now, hold 175, then sprint.

arguments.message: 260 m to go: cue the finish sprint now (no cues allowed in the last 100 m)

arguments.text: 32.3 min, 6040 m, last leg into the current: pod reserve rebuilt to 13 pct (about 2 kJ), enough for only about +6 W over CP for the leg, or a short sprint. Cued push to 175 ground (about 193-196 W). Sprint cue moved to 260 m to go (watch sprint2) because the reserve is small.
